implementation: EXHAUST_MESH_V1 adapter in motorsim/exhaust_mesh_v1.py; explicit independent axial cells per named section; legacy one-cell replace adapter is untouched.
geometry_result: PASS within represented linear circular-frustum axisymmetric sections: exact section lengths/end diameters/interface continuity; exact analytic frustum volume; deterministic shared face mesh; face area and control volume reflect diameter change.
solver_result: Existing IntegratedEngine2T already uses area-weighted HLLC fluxes, actual inlet/outlet face areas, and p*(A_right-A_left)/V momentum source in shared SSPRK2 stages. No solver equation changes. Static variable-area pressure balance, constant-area reduction, wave flux, CFL, checkpoint mismatch and exact restore/restart tests pass.
conservation: Conservative 1/2/4 remapping of density, momentum, total energy and all four species inventories; geometric, mass, species, energy, and six independently recomputed primary audits PASS.
desktop_result: Per-section 1/2/4 selector, mesh boundary drawing, total cells, per-section lengths/face areas/volumes/axial positions, configuration hash and project round-trip integrated; no solver step during editing.
spatial_convergence: NOT_ESTABLISHED. Mean 1-to-2 and 2-to-4 pressure differences do not decrease; A-vs-B pressure and named-interface mass-flow differences increase with refinement. The design response is smaller than the observed refinement sensitivity; 1/2/4 cells per section are insufficient to distinguish design from spatial error.
periodicity: NOT_EVALUATED; one cycle only. No steady power/torque claim.
resolution_recommendation: Use 4 cells per section for further mesh-sensitive exploratory diagnostics and 2 only for interactive preview/prototyping. Neither supports quantitative design ranking. A future 8-cell comparison is technically justified; it was not executed in this bounded 1/2/4 matrix.
resource_limits: Per-run elapsed time and finish RSS recorded; accepted steps, rejected CFL trials, max CFL recorded. CPU utilization and peak RSS were not instrumented. No full RPM campaign, KT100, or experimental validation.
compatibility: New identity is embedded in native geometry_identity and therefore binds engine/project/run/checkpoint hashes.
